name: 武侠黎明
english_description: Martial Arts Dawn (Wuxia Liming) is a Chinese-language wuxia MUD in the Yanhuang/Hell lineage, welcoming newcomers at Yangzhou's Zuixian Inn alongside the Jianghu Envoy across four starting regions (Yangzhou, Beijing, Chengdu, and Guanwai). It spans 25 martial arts sects with sect reputation and Five Greats rankings, faction farms and territory capture, dungeon instances, custom martial arts creation, equipment-affix forging, imperial examinations, and seasonal festivals.
